summary: Phase C iteration_9 (auth-surface fix on /api/admin/crm/*): verified /admin/crm/status and /admin/crm/resync now correctly enforce admin_session_token + admin_users.access_level=0 + MFA via require_access_0. 18/19 passed, 1 intentional skip (see below). The bug-fix headline (customer session_token cookie no longer reaches the CRM endpoint) is confirmed: GET/POST with admin@roobani.dev's session_token now returns 401, previously returned 200.

minor.issue: When HUBSPOT_API_KEY is absent the endpoint early-returns {ok:false, reason:'HUBSPOT_API_KEY not configured', ...} at server.py:1641 BEFORE the `_audit(admin['admin_id'], 'crm.resync', ...)` call at line 1687. Result: no paper trail of who pressed the no-op resync button. The review request's audit assertion (`action='crm.resync' with admin_id starting adm_*`) therefore cannot be exercised on the current preview env until HUBSPOT_API_KEY lands. Suggested fix: move the `_audit(...)` call (with synced=0, queued=0, reason='no_key') ABOVE the early return, OR emit a separate `crm.resync.skipped` audit row in the no-key branch. The adm_* shape itself was verified via the `admin.login` audit row produced by the test fixture's login (admin_id starts with `adm_` and equals super_admin_id from /admin/auth/me).

verified_items: GET /api/admin/crm/status with super-admin admin_session_token -> 200 with {provider:'hubspot', configured:false, pending:{contacts:int, leads:int}, synced:{contacts:int, leads:int}}.
POST /api/admin/crm/resync with super-admin admin_session_token + HUBSPOT_API_KEY absent -> 200 with EXACT body {ok:false, reason:'HUBSPOT_API_KEY not configured', synced:0, queued:0}.
POST /api/contact with NO auth -> 201, doc lands with crm_synced=false (verified via pending counter delta on /admin/crm/status).
Audit row admin_id shape verified to start with `adm_` (from admin.login row keyed to S['super_admin_id'] = /admin/auth/me 'admin_id').

skipped_tests.reason: admin_crm_resync early-returns before _audit() when HUBSPOT_API_KEY is absent (current env). Test skips with a documented note and falls back to verifying the adm_* admin_id shape via the admin.login audit row. Will auto-execute the full assertion once HUBSPOT_API_KEY is set.

action_items: Decide whether /api/admin/crm/resync should emit a `crm.resync` (or `crm.resync.skipped`) audit row even in the no-HUBSPOT_API_KEY branch. Today the early-return at server.py:1641-1642 returns BEFORE the _audit call at line 1687, so there's no paper trail of who hit the button while the key is unconfigured. Two equally good fixes: (a) move the `await _audit(admin['admin_id'], 'crm.resync', 'crm', 'hubspot', {'reason':'no_key','synced':0,'queued':0}, request=request)` ABOVE the `return` in the no-key branch; or (b) emit a distinct action='crm.resync.skipped' there.
When HUBSPOT_API_KEY lands, the existing TestCrmResyncAuth::test_34 will auto-promote from SKIPPED to a real assertion — no test changes needed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1640-1642 — early-return short-circuits the audit. See action_items #1.
server.py:1565-1568 — require_access_0 correctly returns 403 for access_level!=0 and 401 from current_admin when no cookie. Confirmed via test_23 and test_32.

server.py:1687-1694 — _audit call uses positional args admin['admin_id'] first; this is the correct admin_users adm_* id (admin coming from Depends(require_access_0) -> current_admin -> _resolve_admin which loads from admin_users by session token). Confirmed via /admin/auth/me returning admin_id starting `adm_`.

The skipped test will auto-promote to a real assertion once HUBSPOT_API_KEY is set in backend/.env. The headline fix (customer session_token rejected on CRM endpoints) is confirmed in test_21 and test_31. Phase B suite (test_phase_b_admin_bulk.py) is independent and still applicable.
rca of the issue: Iteration_8 flagged the auth-surface as a critical-minor: /admin/crm/* used Depends(require_admin) which checks customer session_token + users.is_admin, allowing admin@roobani.dev (a customer with is_admin=true) to reach the CRM endpoints while completely bypassing admin_users + MFA, and producing audit rows keyed to a customer user_id. iteration_9 swaps the dependency to Depends(require_access_0) -> current_admin -> _resolve_admin from admin_sessions/admin_users. Verified: (a) NO cookie + customer cookie both return 401 (current_admin rejects); (b) manager (access_level=1) admin_session returns 403 (require_access_0 rejects); (c) super-admin admin_session passes and `admin['admin_id']` passed to _audit is the canonical `adm_*` from admin_users. Residual gap: the no-key branch early-returns without auditing — minor and documented in action_items.
